# Location scope, in the plan $g$'s turn (pp_lplan_mark): a line of lowest production efficiency holds for it
# (plan option, pp_tplan_effv_some first: nothing is worked out while no line is set anywhere) and the location's
# lasting production efficiency (scope:pp_tplan_effh = pp_tplan_eff_here, saved as the turn began) is below it.
pp_tplan_eff_low = {
	scope:pp_cplan_country = {
		has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_some
		pp_tplan_eff_line_$g$ > 0.5
		pp_tplan_eff_line_$g$ > scope:pp_tplan_effh
	}
}
